notes.title: A Major Update for The Sisyphus Journey. The Awakening
notes.content: [p]Emptiness... Emptiness demands transformation. The world must begin to breathe anew... The world must awaken...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524174/7e39fa0f1499c5ed39af3b3522dee0e22b7fa69b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]The Awakening:[/h2][p][/p][p]Now, your persistence matters even more. The world is no longer static: at first, it will greet you with a cold, black-and-white void. But your every effort, every conversation, and every decision made will literally breathe life into it, returning colors, sounds, and new inhabitants. You will see the desolate landscape blossom before your eyes, reflecting your inner progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's new in update  "The Awakening":[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New "Living World" Mechanic:[/b] Begin your journey in monochrome despair and watch as the world around you fills with color and detail in response to your actions and interactions with characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Completely Updated Graphics and Animations:[/b] I have redrawn many assets, added effects like swaying trees in the wind, and made many other changes to make the world feel deeper.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Minimalist Interface:[/b] The entire UI has been redesigned to be cleaner, more intuitive, and less distracting from the contemplative process.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fast Travel:[/b] I've heard your feedback! Now, after discovering a new location, you can instantly travel between it and the base camp to give the finger holding down the movement key a little rest.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524174/ffba9c96fa0b6ccfceec533f17881808e7383611.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This update is a big step forward for the game, and I hope it will make your eternal journey even more meaningful and memorable. Thank you for your support and feedback. The path to the summit continues![/p][p]Sincerely, Escapismo.[/p][p][/p][h3]Attention! To enjoy the new version, please delete your old save files.[/h3]

notes.title: "The Sisyphus Journey" Demo Updated Before Release!
notes.content:
Greetings, future conquerors of the summit!

The release of "The Sisyphus Journey" is getting closer – the game launches on April 23rd! As part of the final preparations, I've introduced a number of improvements and fixes, and I'm happy to announce that I've updated the demo version so you can evaluate the latest changes.

What's new in the demo:

[list]
[*] Localization: Added support for Simplified Chinese.
[*] Story and Dialogues: Dialogue texts have been reworked and improved.
[*] Visual Improvements: I've updated the graphics, refined the weather effects, and added detail to some environmental elements.
[*] Animations: The stone interaction animation has been slightly adjusted.
[/list]

I invite you to try out the updated demo version right now!

I would be very grateful for your feedback and impressions. There's still a little time before release to add the final touches based on your feedback. Thank you for being with me on this journey!

notes.title: Dev-log. Explaining gameplay
notes.content:
Someone asked me in dms, what is this game about? I'll tried to give a fast answer, but i could not. And I decided to write a post about it. 

[b]Briefly about the plot of the story:[/b]

There was a man (his name might have been Sisyphus, but most likely not. But we will call him Sisyphus). He lived like many others. A wife, two children, nothing remarkable. Day after day, hour after hour, without ambition or success, without purpose or effort. And then came the fateful day. A quarrel with his wife, a slamming door, a bar, a car, the screeching of brakes, the grinding of metal, the sounds of an ambulance... Death.

Then comes awakening. This is neither hell nor heaven. This is another place. Meeting with Him. And He curses Sisyphus. The curse is understandable: Sisyphus will push a stone to the top of a mountain. An impossible task, but He said that at the top of the mountain they can meet again and perhaps He will give Sisyphus the opportunity to "go". He warned him that no one has ever seen him twice. You cannot die in this world. Your curse will be eternal. Day after day, over and over again.

[b]About the gameplay:[/b]

[previewyoutube=Um6RLvnBlVo;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can understand from the introduction, the main mechanics of the game is pushing a stone to the top of a mountain. The main and only characteristic of the character is strength. Of course, it is not enough to climb the first time. The path to the top goes through 4 locations. Plain, forest, hills and slope. 

The strength decreases as the stone is pushed, and each time the counter reaches zero, Sisyphus will run out of his breath, return to his base camp, and be forced to start over. Yes, it will be long and dreary, but that's the point of the story.

[b]Basecamp:[/b]

The basecamp is the main place of the game. From here we will start the ascent. In the basecamp you will find the main source of power - a fireplace. Each rest near the fire will increase the strength of Sisyphus, so that the next time the ascent will be a little longer.

[previewyoutube=ibmCnJYYXyo;full][/previewyoutube]

The basecampcamp changes as the plot develops, or may not change, depending on which path the player chooses.

[b]Characters:[/b]

It turns out that this world is not empty. There are other people in it who got here the same way as Sisyphus. By chance, or maybe not. In this world you can meet the following NPCs:

[list]
[*] Juliet
[*] Spartacus
[*] Nimrod
[*] Ponce de Leon
[/list]

Through them we can learn a little more about the world around us. Each of them, like Sisyphus, is cursed. In some way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524174/67c37319ba12c20d6dfbdafd82c972f7bcd3857d.jpg[/img]

Juliet dies every day from a poison that somehow gets into her blood. But the world makes her resurrect the next day and it happens again. He said that she can only lift the curse in one way: someone must sacrifice their life for her. But the catch is obvious, you can't die in this world.


Communicating with characters is an optional part of the game. Each conversation with any of the characters will take away your constant strength and move you away from the goal, making the path even more difficult. But if you manage to invite them to your camp - you can get some benefit.


[b]Visions:[/b]

The second part of the story will be told through Sisyphus' visions. It seems that he sometimes sees real-world scenes that happen after his death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524174/6006e4433c89bea0c06355645a39a5b17c342733.png[/img]

Yes, it's Sisyphus' funeral. What will happen to his family? Will it serve as additional motivation or will it make them give up and give up?

[b]Conclusion:[/b]

This game is a story. A story that is told through a difficult test of holding the right movement button, a mediative repetition of locations, over and over again. These are characters who have their own fate, which may be connected to yours. Will they be able to believe that it is possible to get rid of the curse?
This is Sisyphus and the future of his family. Perhaps, having overcome the curse, we will be able to embrace them once more and correct our mistakes? Everything that happens along the way leads to the top of the mountain, where Sisyphus will make a fateful decision.
